name: Matt Austin
notes: Tropicos specimen data against FAIR4AI criteria.Tropicos specimen data can broadly be obtained using two methods: (1) performing a specimen search on the Tropicos "Specimen Search" page or (2) performing an advanced query on the "Advanced Query" page. Because advanced query returns more fields than a general search — and the variable names can differ between a general search and advanced query — I would ideally like to evaluate specimen data obtained through both of these methods against FAIR4AI.
